identity.name: Suspicious HTTP Request with Encoded Command Execution
identity.summary: An attacker downloads a malicious payload via HTTP, executes it with encoded commands, and establishes a C2 connection. Cortex should detect the suspicious HTTP request and process behavior.
identity.description: An attacker downloads a malicious payload via HTTP, executes it with encoded commands, and establishes a C2 connection. Cortex should detect the suspicious HTTP request and process behavior.

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound HTTP request to suspicious IP

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: HTTP Request to Suspicious IP with Encoded Command
biocs.description: Detects HTTP request to a known suspicious IP with encoded command in user-agent or URL
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter action_protocol = ENUM.HTTP
| filter action_user_agent contains 'encoded'
| filter action_url contains 'cmd'

abiocs.name: Suspicious Process Execution After HTTP Download
abiocs.description: Detects execution of a process downloaded via HTTP from a suspicious IP
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name contains '.tmpfile'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'

xql_queries.name: Hunt for Suspicious HTTP Requests
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter action_protocol = ENUM.HTTP
| filter action_user_agent contains 'encoded'
| comp count by action_url, action_remote_ip
